meta.notes: A crate with 27 slots in a vanilla chest screen of 3 rows (msm:container, layout chest). It faces any of six directions, as a barrel does, and shows textures.front_open while a player has it open (the block state open). Each player sees their own items in it (container per_player), as an ender chest: every crate of this id opens the same store for that player, kept when they die or change dimension; hoppers and comparators do not reach it, and breaking it drops only the crate. The open and close sounds are a barrel's unless open_sound and close_sound name others; on_open and on_close run events. Containers need the Fabric mod jar export.
